title: TNT Stab
description: It is a explosion troll mod, made to make you and your friends laugh!
body: With this mod, you get 2 commands can troll and help friends alot, and as one who made this it has been a long project that lasted for a week, but its done now :) Use **/stab**, to summon 500 TNT minecarts infront of you, which explodes on touch! And **/autogear** will clear your inventory, and replace it with really op stuff! I really hope you can prank or get a giggle out of somebody!
